caption: #MyGerberPartner 🎃👻 My first time putting together Halloween boo bags for my toddler’s daycare class, and I couldn’t be more excited! 🥹🧡 Since our little ones aren’t quite ready for all the Halloween candy, I wanted to make something festive, fun, and toddler-friendly! We filled their boo bags with @Gerber fall-inspired Puffs and yummy grain bars for a little Halloween treat! 🍂 Here’s to sweet memories, happy little tummies, and lots of Halloween fun! 🧡 #GerberPartner #Ad #ToddlerHalloween #BooBags
